customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be of good quality and easy to install, with all features working properly. They appreciate its strong security and multiple unlocking options, and find it surprisingly easy to use. While some customers consider it worth the money, others don't buy it, and opinions about keyless access are mixed.
